description: Moves the pre-redesign catch_ui top bar's callers (its route, screen, primaryRail, brand and identity recipes) from CatchTopBar to CatchLegacyTopBar, and the moved file's path, under lib, apps, packages/*/lib and test, test, integration_test, widgetbook/lib and tool/ui_capture, now that CatchTopBar takes the system's six variants. One-shot: --check, --dry-run and the rename run by hand on branches cut before the first caller of the system top bar; CI runs only its tests.
reason: The redesign P2.1 rename landed on main: the pre-redesign components live on as CatchLegacy*, and the system components now own the old names, so this codemod's --check reports correct callers and running it would break them. design:library-shims ratchets the legacy residue. Its callers moved to CatchLegacyTopBar (catch_legacy_top_bar.dart).
